findings.claim: UntrustedData.MaximumObjectGraphDepth is silently raised from 500 to 5000, a breaking security-behavior change unrelated to the generator fix and contrary to the recorded secure-depth-limit decision; existing applications that rely on UntrustedData will accept substantially deeper attacker-controlled graphs.

receipt_plan.detail: Cite ledger L9, which records the stack depth limit of 500 even for trusted data; additionally run a regression test deserializing an untrusted graph deeper than 500 levels and verify that base rejects it while head permits it.
